How a project runs

  1. Call

    We talk through your goals, customers, and budget.

  2. Plan

    You get a page map, a quote, and a fixed timeline.

  3. Build

    You review a live preview link and send feedback as we go.

  4. Launch

    I publish the site and teach you how to edit it.
